text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Developers write unit tests to check small parts of the code, such as individual functions. They also use integration tests to make sure different parts of the system work together correctly. Many teams follow test-driven development, where tests are written before the actual code. This approach helps developers think carefully about what the code should do. Good testing gives the team confidence that their software works as expected and that new changes will not break existing features. Although writing tests takes time, it saves effort in the long run and improves the quality of the final product.
